features.name: Agent Creation Wizard
features.description: A guided wizard in Business Central that allows users to create agents from scratch by providing a name, selecting a profile, setting permissions, and defining instructions without writing code.
caveats: Requires dedicated profile for best practices

features.name: Agent Task Execution with File Attachments
features.description: Agents can process tasks with attachments including PDF files and images, automatically extracting text from images and reading PDF content to understand customer requests.

features.name: Task Log and Execution Tracking
features.description: Users can track agent task execution in real-time through a task log pane that shows all steps the agent is taking, descriptions of actions, and reasons for those actions to enable faster troubleshooting.
caveats: Task log can be maximized for more space

features.name: Agent Action Justification and Audit Trail
features.description: When an agent completes actions like filling fields or creating records, the UI displays eye icons and justifications showing which fields were modified by the agent and why, providing transparency and auditability.

features.name: Task Repeat and Iterative Improvement
features.description: Users can update agent instructions and repeat the same task with identical input data and attachments, allowing for iterative refinement and testing of agent behavior without recreating the entire task.
caveats: Repeats with same input data and attachments

features.name: Agent Request for Human Assistance
features.description: During task execution, agents can request human assistance when they encounter situations they cannot resolve, and users can provide guidance through a review pane to unblock the agent and allow it to continue.
caveats: Agent requests human assistance when needed
Users can provide instructions via review pane

features.name: Copilot Credits Consumption Tracking
features.description: The UI displays copilot credits consumed at the bottom of the task screen, allowing users to see in real-time how many credits a specific task is using.
caveats: Credits shown at bottom of UI

features.name: Instruction Versioning and History
features.description: The system automatically saves all versions of agent instructions as users edit them, and users can view instruction history, compare versions, and download instructions for backup purposes.

features.name: Sales Return Agent Creation
features.description: A specific agent use case demonstrated in this video that helps with customer returns and creates credit memos by reading customer emails and attachments.

features.name: Agent Permission Inheritance from User
features.description: Agent permissions are always limited to the permission set of the user interacting with the agent, meaning even with a super permission set assigned to the agent, it cannot exceed the user's permissions.
